description: Dec 6 meets the reported same-site 75-person threshold, but the accessible EFE-origin page names only a plaza in San Salvador, not which plaza. LPG and EDH exact targets were respectively 403 and decode-error; Diario El Salvador target was 403. No retries.
Dec 12 Plaza Morazán gathering has no crowd estimate. It remains pending_threshold and is not merged with Dec 6.

Searches covered four December weekly windows, labor/public payroll and FODES terms, plus January continuity. Local/departmental diversity and independent count evidence remain limited; no universal Lexis or single-database gate was applied.
